scope: bilingual build123d seed parity, universal task splits, Granite training readiness

coverage.interpretation: Seed parity is complete, but only about one third of seed topics are currently lifted into train/eval/FIM task splits.

quality_findings.detail: English seed corpus is now at full thematic parity with the Czech seed corpus.
Chat train and FIM train are language-balanced between Czech and English.
Chat and FIM data are separated cleanly and reference the same upstream-backed seed corpus via `sources`.
Many seed topics still exist only as seed conversations and have not yet been converted into GENERATE, REVIEW, REPAIR, or FIM tasks.
Holdout eval splits are valid but still small for reliable quality comparison across future training runs.

recommended_next_batch_order.theme: basic solids and 2D shapes still missing from task splits
recommended_next_batch_order.reason: These are high-frequency editor requests and should not live only in the seed corpus.
These patterns are useful for iterative geometry repair and code completion in VS Code.
These are common next-step edits after an initial model already exists.
These examples strengthen universal IDE behavior for inspection, repair, and refactoring-like interactions.

current_readiness.main_bottleneck: expand seed-to-task coverage from 34.21% toward majority coverage
